small_guidance:
- The conv_transpose3d call is left to torch and almost certainly dominates the 10.1 ms; tuning the softmax-sigmoid kernel further (BLOCK_S sweep, num_warps=8) will not move fast_p above ~0.55. Only minor wins available: try BLOCK_S=256/512 with num_warps=8, num_stages=2, and drop the mask on offs_c since C=64 is a power of two.
- Consider folding the conv bias add into the same softmax-sigmoid kernel only after the conv itself is replaced; otherwise the epilogue is already cheap.
large_guidance:
- Replace the torch ConvTranspose3d with a custom Triton scatter-add kernel: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) computing the input×weight outer product and atomically scattering into the output grid with stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1 index math. Fuse the bias add in the producer's epilogue. This is the dominant op and the only path to fast_p > 1.
- Alternative: implement conv_transpose3d as a gather-style direct kernel — one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), iterating over (kd, kh, kw) and gathering the corresponding input voxel when (od+pad-kd) is divisible by stride and in-range. This avoids atomics entirely and is usually faster than scatter on Ampere for fp32.
- Keep softmax+sigmoid fused as a separate second kernel (channel-axis reduction with C=64 fits in one program), but consider persistent-per-(n, spatial) layout with channels-last output from the conv kernel so the softmax loads coalesce along C.
